model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes for six different language model variants—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine linguistic categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these linguistic categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” ranges from 0 to 30 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category contains six colored bars representing the respective models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Error bars are present for each bar, indicating variability. The chart shows that for most categories, the effect sizes for the B₂ models (light pink and dark red) are generally higher than those for the L₂ and R₂ models, with the exception of the IE-Indic category, where the R₂ models (light green and dark green) show the highest effect sizes, reaching approximately 20 and 22 respectively. In the Semitic category, the XLM-B₂ model (dark red) exhibits the highest effect, around 20, while the mBERT-L₂ model (light blue) shows the lowest effect, near 10. For the Isolate category, all models show very low effect sizes, mostly below 2. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the linguistic categories on the x-axis.
